notes.title: Version 1.02 Changes
notes.notes:
Version 1.02 version is OUT!

- Removed the ball basket. One ball spawns in hand when the player pushes the "Grab" button!
- Fixed the Level Selection!
- Fixed various collider issues!
- The "Rules" panel was added to Level 1!
- The player can mute/unmute background music and SFX separately!

notes.title: PreRelease Update Notes
notes.notes:
- Settings Panel has been added, which can be brought up using the Motion Controller! Here the player can change the Movement, Camera height, etc.
- Several minor bugs have been fixed!
- With a Pico HMD, it is possible that when you start the game, the image does not render and you only see a black screen. I am working on a solution to this problem, please bear with me until then! 

If you have any feedback, join my Discord server and share it with me!
